blocks.text: A **broker** is the company through which you buy shares, ETFs and bonds – you can't get onto the stock exchange without one. When choosing, check:

items: **What's on offer** – e.g. a regular ETF investment plan

blocks.text: Your securities are registered **in your name** and kept separate from the broker's assets. If the broker goes bust, you don't lose them.
An **order** is an instruction to buy or sell that you send to your broker. The two basic ones:

items: **Market order** – executed straight away, at the current price
**Limit order** – only at your price or better

blocks.text: To start: **a small amount** (e.g. 25–50 €) and **a limit order** – you won't pay more than you planned.
